name: Syria
shortSummary: India's engagement with Syria has been cautious and limited amid the country's prolonged civil war, deepened by the collapse of the Assad government in December 2024 and the resulting political transition.

majorChallenges.title: Post-2024 political transition
majorChallenges.description: The fall of the Assad government has introduced significant uncertainty into an already-limited relationship.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
